verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev positions itself as a platform for durable AI agents, citing durable tasks, retries, queues and idempotency (gh-1). It documents multi-turn AI chat agents that survive refreshes, deploys and crashes (docs-13), and uses checkpoint-resume so normal TypeScript runs durably (docs-38). It also offers configurable exponential-backoff retries (docs-4) and agent tool calls that pause for approval while the run stays alive (docs-22). Missing for 10: explicit evidence that individual model and tool calls are checkpointed or memoized and retried as separate steps (retries appear task-level), and independent hands-on corroboration of crash recovery mid-agent-loop.
